Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added a Universalis Prices window. It stores a user-defined item list, queries Japan-wide Universalis listings, filters to official JP destination worlds, and groups cheapest results by datacentre/world with travel buttons.
